title: smtp/server.rs: std::process::exit(1) inside async library function
description:
Why this issue exists: In crates/smtp/src/server.rs, run_server calls std::process::exit(1) when credential loading fails during startup. Calling process::exit inside a library-style async function bypasses all Drop handlers, tokio shutdown, and the caller's ability to handle or log the error. It is also untestable.

What needs to be done: Replace the process::exit(1) call with error propagation — return Err(...) and let main() handle the exit.
